options: BTS is the popularest band in the world.
Dad gets up most latest.
This movie is as scariest as the book.
This is the longest river in Asia.
Who is the fastest runner in your team?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: ① popularest → most popular, ② most latest → latest(또는 the latest), ③ as scariest → as scary(원급) 형태여야 하므로 as scary as가 맞다. 따라서 ①②③이 어색하다.

options: Coco is the tallest puppy.
Rami is the shortest of the three.
Rami is as heavy as Coco.
Momo is the heaviest puppy.
Momo is taller than Coco.
questions.question:
다음 표의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

| | Coco | Rami | Momo |
|---|---|---|---|
| Height(cm) | 60 | 47 | 56 |
| Weight(kg) | 15 | 15 | 19 |
questions.explanation: Momo는 56cm, Coco는 60cm이므로 Momo가 Coco보다 크다는 ⑤는 표와 일치하지 않는다.

options: Busan is the biggest port in Korea.
No other port in Korea is as big as Busan.
No other port in Korea is less big than Busan.
Busan is the biggest of all the ports in Korea.
Busan is bigger than any other port in Korea.
questions.question: 다음 중 문장의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ①②④⑤는 모두 '부산이 한국에서 가장 큰 항구'라는 최상급 의미다. ③의 less big than은 '더 작다'는 의미가 되어 뜻이 다르다.

options: You will be the best dancer on your team.
Which is heavier, gold or silver?
Tom has many more coins than Jane.
Who is the more talented actor in Korea?
This is the very best novel.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 셋 이상 중 '가장'을 나타낼 때는 최상급을 써야 하므로 the more talented → the most talented가 맞다. 따라서 ④가 어색하다.

options: Tom works hardest in his office.
Kelly is the most smartest girl in her class.
Paris is the famousest of the French cities.
I think he is best pianist in the world.
Jenny can swim more fast than the others.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 비교급 또는 최상급의 쓰임이 올바른 것은?
questions.explanation: ① hardest는 hard의 올바른 최상급이다. ② most smartest(이중 비교), ③ famousest → most famous, ④ best 앞에 the 필요, ⑤ more fast → faster로 고쳐야 한다.

options: Cathy - taller
Cathy - tallest
Beth - tallest
Beth - taller
Amy - taller
questions.question:
다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 단어를 순서대로 배열한 것은?

Amy is very tall. Beth is taller than Amy. But ___________ is less tall than Cathy. So Cathy is the ___________ of them.
questions.explanation: Beth가 Cathy보다 덜 크므로 Cathy가 가장 크다. 첫 빈칸은 Beth, 둘째 빈칸은 최상급 tallest이므로 ③이 정답이다.

options: wiser - happier - best
wiser - happyer - best
wiseer - happier - best
wiseer - happier - bettest
wiser - happyer - bettest
questions.question:
[표] 위 글의 빈칸 (A)~(C)에 들어갈 말이 순서대로 바르게 연결된 것은?

| 원급 | 비교급 | 최상급 |
|---|---|---|
| tall | taller | tallest |
| wise | (A)____________ | ㉠ wisest |
| happy | (B)____________ | ㉡ happyest |
| big | ㉢ biger | biggest |
| beautiful | more beautiful | most beautiful |
| good | better | (C)____________ |
| bad | worse | ㉣ worest |
| many/much | ㉤ more | most |
| little | ㉥ less | least |
questions.explanation: (A) wise → wiser, (B) happy → happier, (C) good의 최상급은 best이므로 ①이 정답이다.

questions.question: 위 글의 ㉠~㉥ 중 형태가 어색한 것으로 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ㉡ happyest → happiest, ㉢ biger → bigger, ㉣ worest → worst가 잘못된 형태다. ㉠ wisest, ㉤ more, ㉥ less는 올바르다. 따라서 ②가 정답이다.

options: higher, highest, most dangerous
more dangerous, highest, highest
the highest, the higher, dangerousest
high than, the most highest, dangerous
higher than, the highest, most dangerous
questions.question:
빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 고르시오.

Fill in the sentences below with the missing comparatives and superlatives. Mount Everest is ______________ K2. In fact, it is _______________ mountain in the world. Some people even say it's the ________________ mountain to climb.
questions.explanation: 첫 빈칸은 비교급+than(higher than), 둘째는 최상급(the highest), 셋째는 most dangerous가 자연스럽다. 따라서 ⑤가 정답이다.

options: fast - faster
faster - fast
faster – fastest
fastest - faster
fastest – fastest
questions.question:
다음 대화의 괄호 ㉠, ㉡에 주어진 단어가 올바른 형태로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

Sora: This is an animal quiz show. What's the ㉠(fast) animal on land?
Jack: The lion.
Sora: No, it isn't. I think the cheetah is ㉡(fast) than the lion.
questions.explanation: ㉠은 the로 시작하는 최상급(fastest), ㉡은 than과 함께 쓰는 비교급(faster)이므로 ④가 정답이다.

options: Is Mike more tall than Kevin?
That phone is the usefulest of the three.
This box is the bigger than that one.
Jina has the most pens in her class.
David is better player of us.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: ④ the most pens는 올바른 최상급 표현이다. ① more tall → taller, ② usefulest → most useful, ③ the bigger → bigger, ⑤ better player 앞에 the 필요.

options: Who is more politer than Yena?
You have a biggest bag than me.
James is the better player of the three.
When is the happiest time in your life?
Action movies are most exciting than comedy movies.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: ④ the happiest time은 올바른 최상급 표현이다. ①은 이중 비교(more politer) 오류, ②는 a biggest → a bigger, ③은 셋 중 최고이므로 the best player, ⑤는 most exciting → more exciting으로 고쳐야 한다.

options: This is tall than that.
This rock is heavier of all.
She has many books than me.
Who is more diligent, the boy or his dad?
This car is the most expensive than I expected.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: 두 대상을 비교할 때는 비교급 more careful/diligent을 쓰는 것이 맞다. ①은 taller than, ②는 the heaviest of all, ③은 more books than, ⑤는 최상급과 than을 섞어 쓴 오류다.

options: Mike eats least than Sam.
This road is the shorter of all.
Lily is the goodest student in her class.
Danny is bad at solving puzzles than Charles.
My phone is more expensive than my brother's.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: more expensive than은 올바른 비교급 문장이다. ①은 less than, ②는 the shortest of all, ③은 the best, ④는 worse at ... than이 되어야 한다.

options: The Nile is the longest river in the world.
Science is very easier than history.
Cheetahs run fastest among all the animals.
The Han River is the widest in Korea.
Reading books is a lot funnier than playing games.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: 비교급 easier 앞에는 very를 쓸 수 없고 much나 a lot 등을 써야 한다. 나머지 문장은 모두 어법상 올바르다.

options: He is the shortest in our class.
Tom is a lot smarter than his sister.
My pencil is longer than yours.
Steve is more healthy boy in my family.
Which is heavier, my box or yours?
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: '가장 건강한 소년'이라는 최상급 문맥이므로 the healthiest boy가 되어야 한다. more healthy를 쓴 ④가 어색하다.

options: He jumped highest in all.
He is the funnyest actor in Korea.
This is the more exciting book of the five.
Who is more smarter than you in your class?
The turtle is the slowest animal on the farm.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: the slowest animal은 올바른 최상급이다. ①은 of all, ②는 funniest, ③은 the most exciting, ④는 more smarter(이중 비교급)가 오류다.

options: My dad is the best driver.
I am the shortest in the class.
This box is larger than my dog.
His sister looks older than his brother.
The show was most interesting than the movie.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: than과 함께 쓰이므로 비교급 more interesting이 되어야 한다. most interesting을 쓴 ⑤가 어색하다.

options: This is one of the oldest palace in Korea.
Cheetahs run fastest of all the animals.
Jay's new bike is comfortable than his old bike.
February is the most short month of the year.
Busan is bigger than any other cities in Korea.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: run fastest of all은 올바른 최상급 문장이다. ①은 palaces, ③은 more comfortable, ④는 the shortest, ⑤는 any other city(단수)가 되어야 한다.

options: I feel better _______ last week.
China is bigger _______ Korea.
I woke up later ________ my sister.
Bill is the smartest ________ our school.
History is more boring ________ music to me.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 단어가 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ④는 최상급 the smartest이므로 in이 들어가야 하고, 나머지는 모두 비교급이므로 than이 들어간다.

options: Blue whales are the bigger animal in the world.
How bigger are they?
They're 30 meters longer and heavier than 60 buses.
Their tails are the shortest than a dolphin.
They are very larger than a boat.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: longer and heavier than은 올바른 비교급 문장이다. ①은 the biggest, ②는 How big, ④는 최상급과 than 혼용, ⑤는 much larger가 되어야 한다.

options: Suji is tall than Jina and Brian.
Math is the easyest subject to Suji.
Today is the hotest day of this winter.
Sam was the fattest boy in his class last year.
Judy wants to be most famous star in the world.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: the fattest boy는 올바른 최상급이다. ①은 taller than, ②는 easiest, ③은 hottest, ⑤는 the most famous가 되어야 한다.

options: I have more novels than you have.
Minho has more comic books than Gina has.
How many novels do you have?
I'm sure that you'll enjoy it.
Sky group is one of the most wonderful group in Seoul.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: 'one of the 최상급' 뒤에는 복수명사가 와야 하므로 the most wonderful groups가 되어야 한다.

options: Jane is smarter than her sister.
Peter is tallest student in his classroom.
He is the most humorous man in the world.
This red bag is more heavier than that one.
This is the most exciting game than that one.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: ②는 the tallest student로 관사가 필요하고, ④는 more heavier(이중 비교급) 오류이며, ⑤는 최상급과 than을 혼용한 오류다. ①③은 올바르다.

options: I had happiest day of my trip.
This morning is more nice than yesterday.
The red box is the heavier than the blue one.
This yellow hat is the most pretty than that black hat.
The price of The Silent Room is lower than that of Winter Story.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 올바른 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤는 'A의 가격'과 'B의 가격'(that of ~)을 올바르게 비교한 문장이다. ①은 the happiest day, ②는 nice의 비교급 nicer, ③은 heavier than(the+비교급+than 불가), ④는 prettier than이 되어야 한다.

options: I am not so tall as you.
Mia is one of the smartest students in my class.
I want to build the tallest tower in the city.
Today is much more colder than yesterday.
Sarah's bag is as heavy as mine.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
questions.explanation: colder 자체가 이미 비교급이므로 more colder는 이중 비교급으로 틀리다. much colder라고 해야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 비교급과 최상급의 형태가 올바른 것은?

Mina is a music teacher in Busan. She is ⓐthe beautifulest teacher. And she is one of ⓑthe thinest teachers. Students like her a lot because she is ⓒthe funniest music teacher. Mina teacher is ⓓmore tall than any other teacher in school. Also she works in ⓔthe most high building in Busan.
questions.explanation: ⓐ the most beautiful, ⓑ the thinnest, ⓓ taller, ⓔ the highest가 옳은 형태다. ⓒ the funniest는 올바른 최상급 형태이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 쓰임이 어색한 것은?

10 years ago, I wanted to be a science teacher. Because I liked to study science, I learned it ⓐfaster than other friends. Also my science teacher said to me, "You can be the ⓑbest teacher in the future. And you are good at explaining science better
ⓒ then me!" I was really happy to ⓓhear that. So I decided to study science ⓔharder than before.
questions.explanation: 비교급 문장에서 비교 대상 앞에는 than을 써야 하므로 then은 than으로 고쳐야 한다.

options: 2개
3개
4개
5개
6개
questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 맞는 문장의 개수는?

ⓐ Minho looks angrier than Sujin.
ⓑ Hana got more serious because of she didn't do well on the test.
ⓒ He is the luckiest man in the world.
ⓓ Jaeseok is famouser than Myeongsu.
ⓔ Suji is thinner than Jia. ⓕ It is the best delicious food in the world.
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓔ가 옳다(3개). ⓑ는 because of 뒤에 절이 올 수 없어 because로 고쳐야 하고, ⓓ는 more famous, ⓕ는 the most delicious가 옳다.

options: ⓐ - as faster
ⓑ - very
ⓒ - the oldest
ⓓ - cheaper
ⓔ - person
questions.question:
다음 중 빈칸 ⓐ∼ⓔ에 들어갈 말로 바르게 연결된 것은?

• Can a boy run ⓐ________ as a deer?
• It was ⓑ________ worse than I expected.
• He is ⓒ________ of all his family members.
• A plastic stool is less ⓓ________ than a sofa.
• Suji is one of the smartest ⓔ________ in our school.
questions.explanation: ⓐ as fast, ⓑ much(비교급 강조), ⓓ comfortable(less 뒤 원급), ⓔ students(one of the 뒤 복수)가 옳다. ⓒ the oldest는 최상급으로 올바르게 연결된다.
